notes: Official mongo:7 image (7.0.x). mongo:8 (8.3.9) refuses to start on this host's Linux 7.0.0 kernel (SERVER-121912: TCMalloc rseq incompatibility with kernels 6.19-7.0.13, exits at startup, no bypass) so the lab pins 7.0. 3-member replica set rs0 (priorities 3/2/1) initiated by a one-shot mongosh container; no auth. Per-node targets use directConnection=true; writes w=1 unless an experiment says otherwise. $vectorSearch is Atlas / mongot-only, so vector_knn is unsupported on Community.
